name: GLMS CI Pipeline

# 1. When should this run?
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

# 2. What should it do?
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest # It starts a fresh Linux virtual machine

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4 # It "downloads" your code into the VM

    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: 8.0.x # Matches your project version

    - name: Restore Dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Build Project
      run: dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release

    - name: Run Unit Tests
      run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal
